    return json.loads((HERE/'coverage.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))

    source_ids = {d['id'] for d in json.loads((ROOT/'docs/catalog.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))['documents'] if d['original_bank_source']}

    assert len(d['source_accounting']) == 23
    ts = d['topics']; tb = {t['id']:t for t in ts}
    assert len(ts) == len(tb)
    assert {t['module'] for t in ts} == set(range(1,8))
    texts = {(lang,num): (ROOT/f'docs/text/{lang}/{num}.txt').read_text(encoding='utf8')
             for lang in ['EN','TC'] for num in source_ids}
    normalized = {key:norm(s) for key,s in texts.items()}
    count_quotes=0; mapped=set(); count_evidence=0
    for path, sha in d['source_hashes'].items():
        verify_hash(path, sha, state)
    for t in ts:
        assert t['status'] in STATUS
        assert set(t['docs']) <= source_ids
        assert t['missing_aspects'] or t['status'] not in ['partial','missing'], t['id']
        for e in t['evidence']:
            q=qb[e['question_id']]; mapped.add(q['id'])
            check_snapshot(q, e['statements'], e['snapshot'], (t['id'], q['id']))
            count_evidence+=len(e['statements'])
        for p in t['source_pages']:
            assert all(1<=n<=len(texts[p['language'],p['doc']].split('\f')) for n in p['pages']),t['id']
        for quote in t['source_quotes']:
            assert norm(quote['text']) in normalized[quote['language'],quote['doc']],f'quote mismatch {t["id"]}: {quote["text"][:70]}'
            count_quotes+=1
    for finding in d['correctness_findings']:
        for quote in finding['source_quotes']:
            assert norm(quote['text']) in normalized[quote['language'],quote['doc']]
    linked = [tid for b in d['backlog'] for tid in b['topic_ids']]
    assert len(linked)==len(set(linked))
    assert set(linked)=={t['id'] for t in ts if t['status'] in ['partial','missing']}

            assert qid in qb and qid not in mapped
            added.append(qid)

    retired = {r['old_id'] for r in (state['implementation'] or {}).get('replacements', [])}
    retired.update(r['old_id'] for r in (state.get('remaining_implementation') or {}).get('replacements', []))
    assert set(state['current'])==(mapped|set(added))-retired, 'unrecorded bank addition/removal'
    return dict(topic_count=len(ts),mapped_questions=len(mapped),source_quotes=count_quotes,

    details=['# 逐项考点覆盖表','', '[返回结论与补题顺序](README.md)','',

    for m in range(1,8):

            if t['module']!=m: continue

            if line.startswith('经营账户任务B16尚有'):readme[i]='B16已按《牌照指引》第11.1(j)段直接测试准许户名清单。新题不解释或扩张《业务计划指引》第8项未定义的“第三方”一词；此跨文件边界仍如实保留。'

        readme=[line.replace('本轮已补','已落实') for line in readme]

                 f'本次净增{completion["statistics"]["net_questions"]}题、{completion["statistics"]["net_statements"]}个题句；扩写题以新题号替代，旧题快照及原成绩保留。详见[完成记录](REMAINING.md)及[最终证据](remaining-implementation.json)。','']

    if (HERE/'active26-implementation.json').exists():
        readme = [
            '> The original 23-source audit reports below describe the preserved historical',
            '> baseline. Current 01–26 scope and additions are verified separately in',
            '> [ACTIVE-SCOPE.md](ACTIVE-SCOPE.md). Historical completion is not current coverage.',
            '> v1.10.1 updates the seven-part reading material, not this historical question audit.',

            '> v1.10.1筆記的覆核另列；以下歷史題庫審核不作新版筆記完整性的證明。',
            '',
        ] + readme
    return {'README.md':'\n'.join(readme),'COVERAGE.md':'\n'.join(details)}

def main():
    d=read(); v=validate(d); outputs=render(d,v); check='--check' in sys.argv
    if check:
        assert d['validation']==v, 'saved validation counts differ'
    else:
        d['validation']=v
        (HERE/'coverage.json').write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
    for filename, text in outputs.items():
        emit(HERE/filename, text, check)
    print(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

function remember(key,value){try{sessionStorage.setItem('mso-study-'+key,value)}catch{}}
function recall(key){let v=params.get(key);try{v=v||sessionStorage.getItem('mso-study-'+key)}catch{}return v}
// Study tier filter: show every block, hide Recognise/Reference, or show Remember only.
function tier(t){
 if(!['all','MU','M'].includes(t))t='all';
 document.body.dataset.tier=t;

 remember('tier',t);
}
// Ruling marks are a verification aid; they stay hidden until asked for.
function rulings(on){
 document.body.dataset.rulings=on?'on':'off';
 if(rulingsButton)rulingsButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));
 remember('rulings',on?'on':'off');
}
function anchorOffset(){
 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--anchor-offset',(Math.ceil(toolbar.getBoundingClientRect().height)+16)+'px');
}
function revealHash(){
 const target=document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
 if(target)target.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});
}
function language(lang){
 if(!['tc','en','both'].includes(lang))lang='tc';
 const destination=document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
 const offset=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).scrollPaddingTop)||0;
 const atDestination=destination&&Math.abs(destination.getBoundingClientRect().top-offset-(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(destination).scrollMarginTop)||0))<32;
 document.body.dataset.lang=lang;document.documentElement.lang=lang==='en'?'en':'zh-Hant';
 buttons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.language===lang)));
 try{sessionStorage.setItem('mso-study-language',lang)}catch{}
 document.querySelectorAll('.part-nav a,.practice-link,footer a,.visual-links a,.ruling-elsewhere a').forEach(a=>{
  const u=new URL(a.href);u.searchParams.set('lang',lang);a.href=u.href;
 });
 anchorOffset();
 // Preserve a just-followed reference without jumping back to an old hash after scrolling.
 if(atDestination)requestAnimationFrame(()=>{anchorOffset();revealHash()});
}
buttons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>language(b.dataset.language)));
tierButtons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>tier(b.dataset.tier)));
if(rulingsButton)rulingsButton.addEventListener('click',()=>rulings(document.body.dataset.rulings!=='on'));
// Following a ruling link needs the marks on screen.
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const a=e.target.closest('a[href^="#ruling"]');if(a&&document.body.dataset.rulings!=='on')rulings(true)});
let saved=params.get('lang');
try{saved=saved||sessionStorage.getItem('mso-study-language')}catch{}
language(saved||'tc');
tier(recall('tier')||'all');
rulings(recall('rulings')==='on'||/^#ruling/.test(location.hash));
if('ResizeObserver' in window)new ResizeObserver(anchorOffset).observe(toolbar);
window.addEventListener('resize',anchorOffset);
// Resolve the initial hash only after fonts and the chosen language determine height.
document.fonts.ready.then(()=>{anchorOffset();if(location.hash)revealHash()});
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{anchorOffset();revealHash()});

nav.forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>current(a.dataset.section)));

 },{rootMargin:'-145px 0px -65% 0px',threshold:0});
 document.querySelectorAll('.chapter').forEach(s=>observer.observe(s));
}
current(location.hash.slice(1)||nav[0]?.dataset.section);
})();

/* Relationship words, local branches and independent clock origins carry meaning.
   No remote assets, pan/zoom requirement or colour-only semantic distinction. */
.visual-intro{font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 24px;max-width:76ch}
.memory-panel h4{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--accent)}

.path-track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.path-node{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:12px 0;border-top:2px solid var(--accent);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.path-edge{flex:0 1 105px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted)}

.path-note,.relation-note,.clock-note{font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;margin:16px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.relation-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(100px,.8fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px 20px;align-items:center;padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.relation-entity{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent);padding:12px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.relation-verb{font-size:14px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}
.relation-verb>span[aria-hidden]{display:block;font-size:26px}
.relation-note{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}
.independent-clocks{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.clock-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.35fr);gap:12px 32px;padding:25px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.clock-row h4,.clock-note{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}
.clock-origin{position:relative;padding-left:22px;font-size:16px}
.clock-origin::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:10px;left:0;width:9px;height:9px;border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:50%;background:white}
.clock-duration{position:relative;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;border-top:2px solid var(--accent);padding-top:10px}
.clock-label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:500}
.decision-tree{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0;counter-reset:branch}
.decision-node{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:34px;padding:0 0 20px 26px;border-left:2px solid var(--line);margin-left:12px}
.decision-condition{position:relative;padding:18px 0;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}
.decision-number{position:absolute;left:-40px;top:12px;width:26px;height:26px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--accent);color:white;font-size:13px;line-height:1;border-radius:50%}
.decision-outcome{position:relative;padding:18px 0 18px 18px;font-size:16px;border-left:2px solid var(--line)}
.decision-outcome::before{content:"→";position:absolute;left:-28px;top:18px;color:var(--accent)}
.branch-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--accent);font-size:13px}

.decision-node:last-child{padding-bottom:0;border-left-color:transparent}

.logic-group{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(85px,.25fr) minmax(0,1fr);margin:20px 0;align-items:center}
.logic-operator{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;font-weight:650;color:var(--accent);padding-right:18px;text-align:right}
.logic-group>ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 24px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent)}

.logic-group li:last-child{border-bottom:0}

.visual-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 24px;margin:20px 0;font-size:14px}
.stage-sequence{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0;padding-bottom:0}

.stage-sequence .visual-path{padding:0;border:0}

.stage-sequence .path-note{font-size:14px}

/* Amount thresholds: one ordinal line, filled = equality included, hollow = must exceed. */
.threshold-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 28px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.threshold-legend>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.threshold-legend .lane-marker{position:static;transform:none;flex:none}
.threshold-chart{border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.threshold-axis,.threshold-lane{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.6fr);column-gap:28px}
.threshold-axis{padding:14px 0 6px}
.axis-track,.lane-track{position:relative}
.axis-track{height:22px}
.axis-tick{position:absolute;left:var(--at);transform:translateX(-50%);font:500 13px/22px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.threshold-group>h4{margin:0;padding:18px 0 4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em}
.threshold-group+.threshold-group{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.threshold-lane{padding:14px 0 16px;row-gap:6px}
.threshold-lane+.threshold-lane{border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lane-label{grid-row:span 2}
.lane-name{margin:0;font-weight:650;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.6}
.lane-boundary{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.lane-track{height:30px;align-self:start;margin-top:22px;background:linear-gradient(var(--line),var(--line)) 0 50%/100% 1px no-repeat}
.lane-guide{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:0;bottom:0;border-left:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lane-bar{position:absolute;left:var(--at);right:0;top:50%;height:6px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:var(--accent);border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
.lane-bar.exclusion{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent) 0 4px,transparent 4px 8px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
.lane-marker{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:50%;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2.5px solid var(--accent);background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;z-index:1}
.lane-marker.exclusive{background:var(--paper)}
.lane-value{position:absolute;left:var(--at);bottom:100%;transform:translateX(-50%);font:500 12px/18px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.lane-value[style*="80%"]{transform:translateX(-60%)}
.lane-trigger{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.lane-trigger>b{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-right:8px}
.lane-detail{grid-column:1/-1;margin:2px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}
.threshold-scale-note{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}

 .threshold-axis,.threshold-lane{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .threshold-axis>span:first-child{display:none}
 .axis-tick{font-size:11px}
 .axis-tick[style*="58%"]{transform:translateX(-70%)}
 .axis-tick[style*="80%"]{transform:translateX(-25%)}
 .lane-label{grid-row:auto}
}

.tier-chip{display:inline-block;vertical-align:.18em;margin-right:10px;padding:1px 8px;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:3px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.tier-chip.tier-M{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper)}

.concept-block.tier-block-F>h3{color:var(--muted)}

body[data-lang=both] .study-key .key-traps>.en{display:inline;margin:0}
body[data-lang=both] .study-key .key-traps>.en::before{content:" / "}
/* Exam traps: the design system's amber annotation, reserved for labelled confusions. */

.exam-traps>h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:15px;color:var(--warning)}

/* Deadlines: one mini track per row, each with its own starting event. */
.deadline-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.deadline-legend>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.deadline-key{display:inline-block;flex:none;width:28px;height:6px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:var(--accent)}

.deadline-chart{border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}

Vulnerability concerns exploitable weaknesses. Assessment combines quantitative and qualitative information on both; it is not a mechanical formula for an individual transaction.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">2022年整體洗錢風險為中高，威脅中高、脆弱性中等；恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散融資整體均為中低。這些屬報告當年的整體評估，不能代替個別機構或客戶評估。</span><span class="en" lang="en">The 2022 overall ML risk is medium-high, with medium-high threat and medium vulnerability. Overall TF and PF risks are medium-low. These are dated aggregate findings, not substitutes for institutional or customer assessment.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">本地詐騙洗錢威脅高、毒品相關中高；外地詐騙高，外地毒品、貪污及稅務犯罪中高。金錢服務行業的威脅、脆弱性及整體洗錢風險均中高，跨境詐騙得益是重要威脅。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Local fraud presents high ML threat and drug crime medium-high. Foreign fraud is high, and foreign drugs, corruption and tax crime medium-high. MSO threat, vulnerability and overall ML risk are medium-high; cross-boundary fraud proceeds are an important threat.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">行業弱點包括現金密集、跨境及一次性客戶、資源有限、難核實貿易背景、網上／流動服務和不透明結算。Hawala透過經紀網絡、信任及其他結算安排轉移價值；不經傳統銀行不代表沒有金錢服務或洗錢風險。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Vulnerabilities include cash, cross-boundary/one-off customers, limited resources, difficulty verifying trade, online/mobile services and opaque settlement. Hawala moves value through broker networks, trust and alternative settlement; operating outside traditional banking does not remove money-service or ML risk.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">政府以跨部門協作及風險為本監管應對；海關結合機構風險及業務影響程度安排實地／非實地監察、外展、培訓及執法。報告中的歷史數字及季度申報安排不能當成現時統計或半年申報規則。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Interdepartmental coordination and risk-based supervision support mitigation. C&ED combines institutional risk and business impact in on/off-site monitoring, outreach, training and enforcement. Historical statistics and quarterly returns in the report are not current statistics or the half-yearly rule.</span></li></ul><div class="citations"><div class="source-citation"><div class="tc" lang="zh-Hant"><a href="../../docs/TC/25_%E4%B8%AD%E9%81%B8%E8%AE%80_%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E6%B4%97%E9%8C%A2%E5%8F%8A%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E5%88%86%E5%AD%90%E8%B3%87%E9%87%91%E7%B1%8C%E9%9B%86%E9%A2%A8%E9%9A%AA%E8%A9%95%E4%BC%B0%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%EF%BC%882022%E5%B9%B4%EF%BC%89.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">25_中選讀_香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告（2022年）.pdf</a><span class="locator">行政摘要；第2.1–2.10、5.4.1–5.4.29段</span></div><div class="en" lang="en"><a href="../../docs/EN/25_Medium-Selected_Hong%20Kong%20Money%20Laundering%20and%20Terrorist%20Financing%20Risk%20Assessment%20Report%20%282022%29.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">25_Medium-Selected_Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022).pdf</a><span class="locator">Executive summary; ¶2.1–2.10, 5.4.1–5.4.30</span></div></div></div></div><div class="concept-block tier-block-F"><h3><span class="tier-chip tier-F"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">參考</span><span class="en" lang="en">Reference</span></span><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">報告的研究背景及行業概況</span><span class="en" lang="en">Research context and sector profile</span></h3><ul class="concept-list"><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">香港2018年發表首份評估。第二次評估於2021年完成，報告於2022年發表；主要分析2016–2020年的五年數據，並載有其後部分發展。資料來自政府、監管、執法及私人業界。世界銀行方法結合數據及專家判斷分析威脅與脆弱性，先收集／分析及採取中期措施，再覆核更新。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Hong Kong published its first assessment in 2018. The second assessment was completed in 2021 and published in 2022, primarily analysing five-year data for 2016–2020 and also reporting some later developments. Government, regulators, law enforcement and the private sector contributed. The World Bank methodology combines data and expert judgement on threats/vulnerabilities, with initial analysis/interim measures followed by review/update.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">2021年有805個持牌MSO，621個有特定處所、184個沒有（約77%／23%）；首份評估的比較數為1,309。報告列街舖型約53%、外傭匯款約12%、兼營型約9%、不向公眾開放的公司客戶型約3%。這些是該版研究統計，不能用作現時持牌人數。</span><span class="en" lang="en">In 2021 there were 805 licensees: 621 with and 184 without particular premises (about 77%/23%), compared with 1,309 in the first assessment. Street-level operators accounted for about 53%, foreign-domestic-helper remitters 12%, side-business operators 9%, and corporate-only operators not open to the public 3%. These are the report’s historical statistics.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">外傭匯款研究以菲律賓／印尼銀行渠道為主，當時未見Hawala明顯威脅；不代表其他渠道或未來永遠低風險。網上服務需要相稱科技、紀錄、核實及監察，持牌身份不會令替犯罪集團匯款的行為合法。</span><span class="en" lang="en">The FDH remittance study mainly found Philippine/Indonesian banking routes and no evident Hawala threat then; it does not establish permanently low risk elsewhere. Online services need proportionate technology, records, verification and monitoring. Licensing does not legalise remitting for criminal groups.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">報告首次評估擴散融資：威脅及整體風險中低，開放跨境金融、國際貿易及複雜企業／付款網絡可被規避制裁者利用；依定向制裁、擁有權透明度、海關與金融監管／情報合作減低風險。</span><span class="en" lang="en">The report’s first PF assessment rates threat and overall risk medium-low. Open cross-border finance, international trade and complex corporate/payment networks can be exploited for sanctions evasion. Targeted sanctions, ownership transparency and Customs/financial-supervisory/intelligence cooperation mitigate it.</span></li></ul><div class="citations"><div class="source-citation"><div class="tc" lang="zh-Hant"><a href="../../docs/TC/25_%E4%B8%AD%E9%81%B8%E8%AE%80_%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E6%B4%97%E9%8C%A2%E5%8F%8A%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E5%88%86%E5%AD%90%E8%B3%87%E9%87%91%E7%B1%8C%E9%9B%86%E9%A2%A8%E9%9A%AA%E8%A9%95%E4%BC%B0%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%EF%BC%882022%E5%B9%B4%EF%BC%89.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">25_中選讀_香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告（2022年）.pdf</a><span class="locator">2022年版，前言；行政摘要第3–5、24–29段；第2.4–2.9、5.4.1–5.4.12段</span></div><div class="en" lang="en"><a href="../../docs/EN/25_Medium-Selected_Hong%20Kong%20Money%20Laundering%20and%20Terrorist%20Financing%20Risk%20Assessment%20Report%20%282022%29.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">25_Medium-Selected_Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022).pdf</a><span class="locator">2022 edition, Foreword; Executive summary ¶3–5, 24–29; ¶2.4–2.9, 5.4.1–5.4.12</span></div></div></div></div><div class="concept-block tier-block-U"><h3><span class="tier-chip tier-U"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">理解</span><span class="en" lang="en">Understand</span></span><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">五級風險尺度與恐怖主義／融資的區別</span><span class="en" lang="en">Five risk levels and terrorism versus financing</span></h3><ul class="concept-list"><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">第25份把威脅理解為犯罪得益／恐怖主義相關資金的產生、流入及流出的規模與特徵；脆弱性是整體或行業防線的弱點／缺口。五級是低、中低、中、中高、高；評估不等於替個別交易指定一個固定數學分數。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Document 25 treats threat as the scale/patterns of generation, inflows and outflows of proceeds or terrorism-linked funds, and vulnerability as territory/sector defence weaknesses. Its five levels are low, medium-low, medium, medium-high and high; these are not a fixed mathematical transaction score.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">2022年報告第8.5段的恐怖襲擊威脅為「中（moderate）」：屬高／中／低的三級警戒，意思是香港可能受到襲擊，但沒有具體情報顯示會成為襲擊目標。這與五級風險尺度下的恐怖分子資金籌集威脅／風險「中低」不同；襲擊威脅與籌資／轉資風險不可互換，亦不是現時已核實的安全判斷。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Paragraph 8.5 of the 2022 report rates terrorist-attack threat “moderate” on a three-level high/moderate/low alert scale: an attack is possible, but there is no specific intelligence suggesting Hong Kong is likely to be a target. This differs from medium-low TF threat/risk on the five-level risk scale. Attack threat and fund-raising/movement risk are distinct, and these dated findings are not a verified current security assessment.</span></li></ul><div class="citations"><div class="source-citation"><div class="tc" lang="zh-Hant"><a href="../../docs/TC/25_%E4%B8%AD%E9%81%B8%E8%AE%80_%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E6%B4%97%E9%8C%A2%E5%8F%8A%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E5%88%86%E5%AD%90%E8%B3%87%E9%87%91%E7%B1%8C%E9%9B%86%E9%A2%A8%E9%9A%AA%E8%A9%95%E4%BC%B0%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%EF%BC%882022%E5%B9%B4%EF%BC%89.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">25_中選讀_香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告（2022年）.pdf</a><span class="locator">2022年版，第2.4–2.5、8.5段；行政摘要第18–23段</span></div><div class="en" lang="en"><a href="../../docs/EN/25_Medium-Selected_Hong%20Kong%20Money%20Laundering%20and%20Terrorist%20Financing%20Risk%20Assessment%20Report%20%282022%29.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">25_Medium-Selected_Hong Kong Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Report (2022).pdf</a><span class="locator">2022 edition, ¶2.4–2.5, 8.5; Executive summary ¶18–23</span></div></div></div></div><div class="concept-block tier-block-U"><h3><span class="tier-chip tier-U"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">理解</span><span class="en" lang="en">Understand</span></span><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">2022年報告中的公司及戶口濫用</span><span class="en" lang="en">company and account misuse in the 2022 report</span></h3><ul class="concept-list"><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">空殼公司（shell company）可沒有實質營運而被用作隱藏擁有人或轉款；掛名公司（front company）則以貌似或實際合法業務及收支掩飾犯罪得益。2022年報告提到單一股東／董事、與香港無關連、業務含糊及資金頻繁大額進出而結餘低的組合警號；單一特徵不等於犯罪。</span><span class="en" lang="en">A shell company may lack substantive operations and be used to hide ownership or move funds. A front company uses apparently or actually legitimate business and receipts/payments to disguise criminal proceeds. The 2022 report describes combinations of sole ownership/directorship, no Hong Kong nexus, vague business and frequent large flows with low balances; no single feature proves crime.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">錢騾／傀儡戶口（money mule／stooge account）：由他人名義持有或控制、被用來接收及轉移犯罪得益的戶口；應留意持有人是否真正控制及了解交易。報告所述高速收轉款、小額試轉及更換戶口／裝置等，是需要與客戶背景一起評估的手法。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Money-mule or stooge accounts are accounts in other persons’ names or control used to receive and move criminal proceeds. Examine whether the holder genuinely controls and understands the activity. Rapid receipt and dissipation, small test transfers and changing accounts/devices described in the report need assessment alongside the customer profile.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">挪用現金補空（cash kiting，循環轉款）：在同一方控制的多個個人／公司之間循環轉款，虛增營業額或薪酬以取得未獲授權的額外貸款／信貸。最初循環的款項未必是犯罪得益，但藉欺詐取得的額外貸款／信貸款項會被視作犯罪得益；不是每個循環轉帳都自動構成這種手法。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Cash kiting circulates funds among individuals/entities under common control to inflate turnover or payroll and obtain unauthorized additional loans/credit. The initial circulating money need not be criminal proceeds; money generated from the additional loan/credit obtained through the fraud would be considered crime proceeds. Consolidated (24 Sep 2026).pdf</a><span class="locator">Parts 5B, 5C</span></div></div></div></div><div class="concept-block tier-block-R"><h3><span class="tier-chip tier-R"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">認識</span><span class="en" lang="en">Recognise</span></span><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">例子：保險、物業及專業服務如何被濫用</span><span class="en" lang="en">Examples: misuse of insurance, property and professional services</span></h3><ul class="concept-list"><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">2022年報告的保險例子：犯罪得益購買保險後提取款項，取得看似正常的保險公司支票，可用作<strong class="recall-term">分層</strong>；長期持有人壽保單或變額年金則可用作<strong class="recall-term">整合</strong>。報告指出，當時香港在<strong class="recall-term">分層</strong>階段購買保險並不常見，而整合階段較多；這不是說任何保險付款都可豁免來源審查。</span><span class="en" lang="en">The 2022 report gives insurance examples: buying insurance with proceeds and withdrawing to obtain an apparently normal insurer cheque can serve <strong class="recall-term">layering</strong>; holding life policies or variable annuities for longer can serve <strong class="recall-term">integration</strong>. function recall(key){let v=params.get(key);try{v=v||sessionStorage.getItem('mso-study-'+key)}catch{}return v}
// Study tier filter: show every block, hide Recognise/Reference, or show Remember only.
function tier(t){
 if(!['all','MU','M'].includes(t))t='all';
 document.body.dataset.tier=t;
 tierButtons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.tier===t)));
 remember('tier',t);
}
// Ruling marks are a verification aid; they stay hidden until asked for.
function rulings(on){
 document.body.dataset.rulings=on?'on':'off';
 if(rulingsButton)rulingsButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));
 remember('rulings',on?'on':'off');
}
function anchorOffset(){
 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--anchor-offset',(Math.ceil(toolbar.getBoundingClientRect().height)+16)+'px');
}
function revealHash(){
 const target=document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
 if(target)target.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});
}
function language(lang){
 if(!['tc','en','both'].includes(lang))lang='tc';
 const destination=document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
 const offset=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).scrollPaddingTop)||0;
 const atDestination=destination&&Math.abs(destination.getBoundingClientRect().top-offset-(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(destination).scrollMarginTop)||0))<32;
 document.body.dataset.lang=lang;document.documentElement.lang=lang==='en'?'en':'zh-Hant';
 buttons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.language===lang)));
 try{sessionStorage.setItem('mso-study-language',lang)}catch{}
 document.querySelectorAll('.part-nav a,.practice-link,footer a,.visual-links a,.ruling-elsewhere a').forEach(a=>{
  const u=new URL(a.href);u.searchParams.set('lang',lang);a.href=u.href;
 });
 anchorOffset();
 // Preserve a just-followed reference without jumping back to an old hash after scrolling.
 if(atDestination)requestAnimationFrame(()=>{anchorOffset();revealHash()});
}
buttons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>language(b.dataset.language)));
tierButtons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>tier(b.dataset.tier)));
if(rulingsButton)rulingsButton.addEventListener('click',()=>rulings(document.body.dataset.rulings!=='on'));
// Following a ruling link needs the marks on screen.

language(saved||'tc');
tier(recall('tier')||'all');
rulings(recall('rulings')==='on'||/^#ruling/.test(location.hash));
if('ResizeObserver' in window)new ResizeObserver(anchorOffset).observe(toolbar);
window.addEventListener('resize',anchorOffset);
// Resolve the initial hash only after fonts and the chosen language determine height.
document.fonts.ready.then(()=>{anchorOffset();if(location.hash)revealHash()});
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{anchorOffset();revealHash()});
const nav=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-section]')];
function current(id){nav.forEach(a=>a.setAttribute('aria-current',a.dataset.section===id?'location':'false'))}

if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
 const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  for(const entry of entries)if(entry.isIntersecting)current(entry.target.id);
 },{rootMargin:'-145px 0px -65% 0px',threshold:0});
 document.querySelectorAll('.chapter').forEach(s=>observer.observe(s));
}
current(location.hash.slice(1)||nav[0]?.dataset.section);
})();

/* Amount thresholds: one ordinal line, filled = equality included, hollow = must exceed. */
.threshold-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 28px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}

.lane-marker{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:50%;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2.5px solid var(--accent);background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;z-index:1}

This does not make every insurance payment exempt from source scrutiny.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">物業交易耗時及成本較高，報告指當時在<strong class="recall-term">存放</strong>／<strong class="recall-term">分層</strong>階段購買物業並不常見，但可用<strong class="recall-term">分層</strong>後的得益購買物業以整合財富。合法資產或正式買賣文件，不會自動清除先前的犯罪來源。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Property transactions take time and incur costs; the report says purchases for <strong class="recall-term">placement</strong>/<strong class="recall-term">layering</strong> were unusual at the time, while proceeds after <strong class="recall-term">layering</strong> could purchase property for integration. A lawful asset or formal sale documentation does not automatically cleanse the prior criminal origin.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">專業服務的風險不限於專業人士知情合謀：犯罪分子可提供偽造文件讓會計師核數，利用律師代管聲稱來自合法業務／投資的款項，或利用TCSP成立公司、擔任公司秘書／受託人及協助開戶。應理解服務如何掩蓋真實活動，不能單憑有會計師、律師或公司秘書參與便視為資金合法。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Risk does not require knowing collusion by a professional: criminals may supply forged documents for accountants to audit, use lawyers as escrow agents for purported business/investment money, or use TCSPs for company formation, secretarial/trustee services and account-opening assistance. For a carrier, aggregate CBNIs carried by the same carrier for the same customer on that conveyance. The customer must directly engage the carrier, or directly engage the forwarder who transports or arranges transport of the CBNIs to the carrier. Where that customer engages multiple forwarders, this rule aggregates only items transported, or whose transport is arranged, by the same forwarder to the same carrier. Customer means a person who is not a carrier; do not automatically substitute the freight forwarder for the customer.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">輸入、輸出或安排輸入／輸出的人須確保事前已有合規申報；僅掌管運輸工具而無其他輸入／輸出責任者有第9(2)條例外。通常以電子方式申報；獲系統接納及編配參考編號才算完成。關長認為電子傳送並非切實可行時，可依關長指示採另一方式；不是自行改用任意紙本程序。旅客、郵包及法定過境／航空轉運貨物豁除另按第8條判斷。</span><span class="en" lang="en">A person importing/exporting or causing import/export must ensure a compliant declaration has been made beforehand; section 9(2) excepts a conveyance operator with no other responsibility for the import/export.  });

Legal professional privilege is preserved, but section 81 does not excuse a client’s name/address.</span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">第15條適用於第12(2)／(3)條強制取得的答覆、解釋或詳情：調查員須先告知／提醒證據使用限制；如內容可能使本人入罪，且本人在提供前作此聲稱，該要求及相關問答／解釋／詳情不得在法院刑事程序中用作針對本人的證據。但就該答覆等被控第13(1)、(3)、(5)–(8)條罪行，或《刑事罪行條例》第V部罪行的程序除外。這不是全面拒答權，也不是所有現存文件的普遍豁免。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Section 15 concerns answers, responses, explanations or particulars compelled under section 12(2)/(3). Consolidated (24 Sep 2026).pdf</a><span class="locator">ss.61–68</span></div></div></div></div></section><section class="chapter" id="other-sector-regimes" aria-labelledby="title-other-sector-regimes"><div class="section-heading"><span class="section-number">11</span><h2 id="title-other-sector-regimes"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">參考：其他行業制度與MSO的界線</span><span class="en" lang="en">Reference: other sector regimes and MSO boundaries</span></h2></div><div class="concept-block tier-block-F reference"><h3><span class="tier-chip tier-F"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">參考</span><span class="en" lang="en">Reference</span></span><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">第5A部信託或公司服務提供者（TCSP）</span><span class="en" lang="en">Part 5A trust or company service providers (TCSPs)</span></h3><ul class="concept-list"><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">信託或公司服務指在香港以業務形式向他人提供一項或以上：成立法團／其他法人；擔任或安排他人擔任董事、秘書、合夥人或其他法人類似職位；向法人／法律安排提供註冊辦事處、營業、通訊或行政地址；擔任或安排他人擔任明示信託／類似法律安排的受託人，或代名股東（不包括證券於認可證券市場上市的法團的代名股東）。第5A部由公司註冊處處長執行。第53B條豁除政府、認可機構、以該業務附屬於主要業務的持牌法團、會計及法律專業人士和訂明類別；豁除本部不等於豁除其他適用AML責任。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Trust or company service means providing, in Hong Kong by way of business to others, one or more of: formation of corporations/other legal persons; acting or arranging directors, secretaries, partners or similar positions for legal persons; registered, business, correspondence or administrative addresses for legal persons/arrangements; acting or arranging trustees of express trusts/similar arrangements or nominee shareholders, excluding nominees for corporations listed on a recognized stock market. .visual-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 24px;margin:20px 0;font-size:14px}

/* Amount thresholds: one ordinal line, filled = equality included, hollow = must exceed. */
.threshold-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 28px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.threshold-legend>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.threshold-legend .lane-marker{position:static;transform:none;flex:none}
.threshold-chart{border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.threshold-axis,.threshold-lane{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.6fr);column-gap:28px}
.threshold-axis{padding:14px 0 6px}
.axis-track,.lane-track{position:relative}
.axis-track{height:22px}
.axis-tick{position:absolute;left:var(--at);transform:translateX(-50%);font:500 13px/22px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.threshold-group>h4{margin:0;padding:18px 0 4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em}
.threshold-group+.threshold-group{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.threshold-lane{padding:14px 0 16px;row-gap:6px}
.threshold-lane+.threshold-lane{border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lane-label{grid-row:span 2}
.lane-name{margin:0;font-weight:650;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.6}
.lane-boundary{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.lane-track{height:30px;align-self:start;margin-top:22px;background:linear-gradient(var(--line),var(--line)) 0 50%/100% 1px no-repeat}
.lane-guide{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:0;bottom:0;border-left:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lane-bar{position:absolute;left:var(--at);right:0;top:50%;height:6px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:var(--accent);border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
.lane-bar.exclusion{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent) 0 4px,transparent 4px 8px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
.lane-marker{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:50%;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2.5px solid var(--accent);background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;z-index:1}
.lane-marker.exclusive{background:var(--paper)}
.lane-value{position:absolute;left:var(--at);bottom:100%;transform:translateX(-50%);font:500 12px/18px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.lane-value[style*="80%"]{transform:translateX(-60%)}
.lane-trigger{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.lane-trigger>b{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-right:8px}
.lane-detail{grid-column:1/-1;margin:2px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}
.threshold-scale-note{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .threshold-axis,.threshold-lane{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .threshold-axis>span:first-child{display:none}
 .axis-tick{font-size:11px}

.tier-chip{display:inline-block;vertical-align:.18em;margin-right:10px;padding:1px 8px;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:3px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}

/* Deadlines: one mini track per row, each with its own starting event. */
.deadline-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.deadline-legend>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}

.deadline-chart{border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.deadline-group+.deadline-group{margin-top:22px}

.deadline-label h4{margin:0;font-size:16px;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.6}

body[data-lang=en] .deadline-start .en,body[data-lang=both] .deadline-start :is(.tc,.en){display:inline;margin:0}
body[data-lang=both] .deadline-start .en::before{content:" / "}
.deadline-track{position:relative;height:30px;margin:24px 0 26px;align-self:start;background:linear-gradient(var(--line),var(--line)) 0 50%/100% 1px no-repeat}
.deadline-seg{position:absolute;left:var(--from);width:calc(var(--to) - var(--from));top:50%;height:6px;transform:translateY(-50%)}

:is(.deadline-seg-label,.deadline-anchor-label).edge-left{transform:translateX(-8px)}

Do not turn these examples into a requirement that ownership/tenancy, advertising and a completed customer transaction must all exist before registration is needed.</span></li><li class="ruled" id="rule-premises-0-1"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">只是食肆／銀行的訪客或顧客，或純為處理公司會計／法律文件而到會計師行／律師行，並不使該處成為自己的特定處所。沒有固定處所的上門服務、在客戶辦公室會客，以及中文所列「只使用流動電子設備」的交易，可屬無特定處所模式；英文原文為使用流動電子設備。店舖同時使用手機不會因此變為無處所經營，無特定處所亦仍須持牌。<a class="ruling-chip kind-lang" href="#ruling-E13" title="裁決 E13：無特定處所：「使用」還是「只使用」流動電子設備"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E13</a></span><span class="en" lang="en">Being only a visitor/customer at a restaurant or bank, or visiting an accountant/solicitor solely for company documents, does not make it the MSO’s particular premises. A shop does not become a no-premises operation merely by also using phones, and no-premises operation still requires a licence.<a class="ruling-chip kind-lang" href="#ruling-E13" title="Ruling E13: Not operating at particular premises: “with the use of” or 只使用 mobile devices"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E13</a></span></li><li class="ruled" id="rule-premises-0-2"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">不適合的例子包括：位於純住宅樓宇內的處所；另一MSO正在用作經營金錢服務或另一申請人已填報申牌／續牌的處所；共用其他業務的入口、未得其佔用人／業主准許或協助便不能進入；或招牌業務名稱與提交的商業登記不同。混合商住處所須每名佔用人書面同意獲授權人進入視察。<a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E10" title="裁決 E10：混合用途大廈每名佔用人的書面同意：「should」還是「須」"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E10</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-between" href="#ruling-B25" title="裁決 B25：住宅處所佔用人同意：讓「獲授權人員」還是「獲授權人」進入"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>B25</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E40" title="裁決 E40：住宅處所同意：「C&ED的獲授權人」還是「海關人員」進入"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E40</a></span><span class="en" lang="en">Unsuitable examples include premises in a wholly residential building; premises already used by another MSO or declared by another grant/renewal applicant; premises whose entrance is another business’s area and cannot be accessed without its occupant/owner’s permission or assistance; or a signboard business name differing from the submitted BR. Mixed commercial/residential premises need every occupant’s written consent for authorized persons to enter for inspection.<a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E10" title="Ruling E10: Every occupant’s written consent: “should” or 須"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E10</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-between" href="#ruling-B25" title="Ruling B25: Occupant’s consent: entry by an “authorized officer” or an “authorized person”"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>B25</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E40" title="Ruling E40: Domestic premises consent: “any authorized person of C&ED” or 海關人員"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E40</a></span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">沒有特定營業處所者須維持本地管理辦事處（LMO）：香港實體辦事處兼通訊地址，可親身及電話聯絡，由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、<strong class="recall-term">最終擁有人</strong>及／或<strong class="recall-term">合規主任</strong>駐守。不接納經營者的住址／住宅處所或其服務供應商（如公司秘書、會計師行、律師行）的地址／處所；須有業主准許作金錢服務用途的租約條款或信件。不是所有有特定處所MSO都另外須設LMO。</span><span class="en" lang="en">No-particular-premises operators maintain an LMO: a physical Hong Kong office/correspondence address reachable in person/by phone, staffed by the proprietor, partner, director, <strong class="recall-term">ultimate owner</strong> and/or CO. Obtain landlord permission for money-service use in the tenancy agreement or a letter. Not every MSO with particular premises needs a separate LMO.</span></li><li class="ruled" id="rule-premises-0-4"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">所有申請人須有香港實體本地紀錄儲存地方（LPS），保存受持牌人控制的完整金錢服務交易帳目及紀錄；不接納經營者的住址／住宅處所或其服務供應商的地址／處所。未交LMO／LPS所需資料的申請無效、不獲處理，亦可成為拒絕發牌理由；未能持續維持可引致暫時吊銷／撤銷。<a class="ruling-chip kind-within" href="#ruling-W3" title="裁決 W3：欠管理辦事處／存放地點資料：無效申請，還是「可」拒批"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>W3</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-within" href="#ruling-W2" title="裁決 W2：沒有維持本地紀錄存放地點：「將」還是「可」導致暫時吊銷／撤銷"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>W2</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E1" title="裁決 E1：沒有維持本地管理辦事處：「將」還是「可」導致暫時吊銷／撤銷"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E1</a></span><span class="en" lang="en">All applicants need a physical Hong Kong LPS holding the complete money-service transaction books/records under the licensee’s control. (()=>{
const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-language]')];
const tierButtons=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-tier]')];
const rulingsButton=document.querySelector('.toggle-rulings');
const toolbar=document.querySelector('.toolbar');
const params=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
function remember(key,value){try{sessionStorage.setItem('mso-study-'+key,value)}catch{}}
function recall(key){let v=params.get(key);try{v=v||sessionStorage.getItem('mso-study-'+key)}catch{}return v}
// Study tier filter: show every block, hide Recognise/Reference, or show Remember only.
function tier(t){
 if(!['all','MU','M'].includes(t))t='all';
 document.body.dataset.tier=t;
 tierButtons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.tier===t)));
 remember('tier',t);
}
// Ruling marks are a verification aid; they stay hidden until asked for.
function rulings(on){
 document.body.dataset.rulings=on?'on':'off';
 if(rulingsButton)rulingsButton.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(on));
 remember('rulings',on?'on':'off');
}
function anchorOffset(){
 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--anchor-offset',(Math.ceil(toolbar.getBoundingClientRect().height)+16)+'px');
}
function revealHash(){
 const target=document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
 if(target)target.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});
}
function language(lang){
 if(!['tc','en','both'].includes(lang))lang='tc';
 const destination=document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));
 const offset=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).scrollPaddingTop)||0;
 const atDestination=destination&&Math.abs(destination.getBoundingClientRect().top-offset-(parseFloat(getComputedStyle(destination).scrollMarginTop)||0))<32;
 document.body.dataset.lang=lang;document.documentElement.lang=lang==='en'?'en':'zh-Hant';
 buttons.forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.language===lang)));
 try{sessionStorage.setItem('mso-study-language',lang)}catch{}
 document.querySelectorAll('.part-nav a,.practice-link,footer a,.visual-links a,.ruling-elsewhere a').forEach(a=>{
  const u=new URL(a.href);u.searchParams.set('lang',lang);a.href=u.href;
 });
 anchorOffset();
 // Preserve a just-followed reference without jumping back to an old hash after scrolling.
 if(atDestination)requestAnimationFrame(()=>{anchorOffset();revealHash()});
}
buttons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>language(b.dataset.language)));
tierButtons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>tier(b.dataset.tier)));
if(rulingsButton)rulingsButton.addEventListener('click',()=>rulings(document.body.dataset.rulings!=='on'));
// Following a ruling link needs the marks on screen.
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const a=e.target.closest('a[href^="#ruling"]');if(a&&document.body.dataset.rulings!=='on')rulings(true)});
let saved=params.get('lang');
try{saved=saved||sessionStorage.getItem('mso-study-language')}catch{}
language(saved||'tc');

.decision-condition{position:relative;padding:18px 0;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;border-top:2px solid var(--accent)}
.decision-number{position:absolute;left:-40px;top:12px;width:26px;height:26px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--accent);color:white;font-size:13px;line-height:1;border-radius:50%}
.decision-outcome{position:relative;padding:18px 0 18px 18px;font-size:16px;border-left:2px solid var(--line)}
.decision-outcome::before{content:"→";position:absolute;left:-28px;top:18px;color:var(--accent)}
.branch-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--accent);font-size:13px}
.decision-continue{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;font-size:15px;padding:12px 0 0}
.decision-continue>b{flex-shrink:0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.decision-node:last-child{padding-bottom:0;border-left-color:transparent}
.decision-end{border-left:3px solid var(--accent);padding:12px 18px;background:var(--wash)}
.logic-group{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(85px,.25fr) minmax(0,1fr);margin:20px 0;align-items:center}
.logic-operator{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;font-weight:650;color:var(--accent);padding-right:18px;text-align:right}
.logic-group>ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 24px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent)}
.logic-group li{font-size:16px;line-height:1.8;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.logic-group li:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.data-packet{padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.data-packet h4{font-size:19px}
.penalty-formula{padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.penalty-formula p{font-size:16px;margin:12px 0}
.penalty-formula .formula-expression{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.7}
.visual-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 24px;margin:20px 0;font-size:14px}
.stage-sequence{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0;padding-bottom:0}
.stage-sequence li+li{padding:24px 0 0;border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.stage-sequence li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.25fr);gap:12px 28px;padding:20px 0}
.stage-sequence li>h4{grid-column:1;margin:0;font-size:21px}
.stage-sequence li>p{grid-column:1;font-size:16px}
.stage-sequence .visual-paths{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;border:0}
.stage-sequence .visual-path{padding:0;border:0}
.stage-sequence .visual-path h4{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.stage-sequence .path-track{gap:10px}
.stage-sequence .path-edge{flex-basis:55px}
.stage-sequence .path-note{font-size:14px}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .relation-row{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(80px,.65fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px}
 .relation-entity{font-size:15px}.relation-verb{font-size:13px}
 .stage-sequence li{display:block}.stage-sequence li>p{margin:12px 0 20px}
 .decision-node{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-left:20px;column-gap:0}

 .decision-condition{font-size:17px}

 .decision-continue{display:block}.decision-continue>b{display:block;margin-bottom:8px}
 .path-track{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:6px}
 .path-edge{flex:auto;text-align:left;padding-left:14px}
 .path-edge>span[aria-hidden]{display:inline-block;transform:rotate(90deg);margin-left:8px}
 .path-node{padding:10px 0;border-top:0;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding-left:14px}
 .clock-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px}.clock-origin{margin-top:4px}
 .clock-duration{margin-left:22px;font-size:17px}

 .logic-group>ul{padding-left:18px}

}
@media(max-width:430px){
 .relation-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:24px 0}

 .relation-verb{text-align:left;padding-left:14px}
 .relation-verb>span[aria-hidden]{display:inline-block;transform:rotate(90deg);margin-left:10px}

.path-edge.comparison-edge>span[aria-hidden]{transform:none}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .memory-table.columns-4 tbody{padding-bottom:8px}

 /* Visually hidden headings stay available to assistive reading tools. */

/* Amount thresholds: one ordinal line, filled = equality included, hollow = must exceed. */
.threshold-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 28px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.threshold-legend>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.threshold-legend .lane-marker{position:static;transform:none;flex:none}
.threshold-chart{border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.threshold-axis,.threshold-lane{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.6fr);column-gap:28px}
.threshold-axis{padding:14px 0 6px}
.axis-track,.lane-track{position:relative}
.axis-track{height:22px}
.axis-tick{position:absolute;left:var(--at);transform:translateX(-50%);font:500 13px/22px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.threshold-group>h4{margin:0;padding:18px 0 4px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em}
.threshold-group+.threshold-group{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.threshold-lane{padding:14px 0 16px;row-gap:6px}
.threshold-lane+.threshold-lane{border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lane-label{grid-row:span 2}
.lane-name{margin:0;font-weight:650;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.6}
.lane-boundary{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.lane-track{height:30px;align-self:start;margin-top:22px;background:linear-gradient(var(--line),var(--line)) 0 50%/100% 1px no-repeat}
.lane-guide{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:0;bottom:0;border-left:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lane-bar{position:absolute;left:var(--at);right:0;top:50%;height:6px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:var(--accent);border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
.lane-bar.exclusion{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent) 0 4px,transparent 4px 8px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent)}
.lane-marker{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:50%;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2.5px solid var(--accent);background:var(--accent);display:inline-block;z-index:1}
.lane-marker.exclusive{background:var(--paper)}
.lane-value{position:absolute;left:var(--at);bottom:100%;transform:translateX(-50%);font:500 12px/18px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.lane-value[style*="80%"]{transform:translateX(-60%)}
.lane-trigger{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.lane-trigger>b{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-right:8px}
.lane-detail{grid-column:1/-1;margin:2px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}
.threshold-scale-note{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .threshold-axis,.threshold-lane{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .threshold-axis>span:first-child{display:none}
 .axis-tick{font-size:11px}
 .axis-tick[style*="58%"]{transform:translateX(-70%)}
 .axis-tick[style*="80%"]{transform:translateX(-25%)}
 .lane-label{grid-row:auto}
}
body[data-lang=en] .lane-trigger .en,body[data-lang=both] .lane-trigger :is(.tc,.en){display:inline;margin:0}
body[data-lang=both] .lane-trigger .en::before{content:" / "}
/* Study tiers: one chip per block; only "Remember" is filled so must-know content stands out. */
.tier-chip{display:inline-block;vertical-align:.18em;margin-right:10px;padding:1px 8px;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:3px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.tier-chip.tier-M{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper)}
.tier-chip.tier-R{border-color:var(--muted);color:var(--muted)}
.tier-chip.tier-F{border-color:var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
body[data-lang=both] .tier-chip>.en{display:inline;margin:0}
body[data-lang=both] .tier-chip>.en::before{content:" / "}
.concept-block.tier-block-F>h3{color:var(--muted)}
.study-key{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 4px;margin:-8px 0 32px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.study-key .key-count{margin-right:14px;font:500 13px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace}
.study-key .key-traps{padding:1px 8px;background:var(--warm);color:var(--warning);border-radius:3px;font-weight:600}
body[data-lang=both] .study-key .key-traps>.en{display:inline;margin:0}
body[data-lang=both] .study-key .key-traps>.en::before{content:" / "}
/* Exam traps: the design system's amber annotation, reserved for labelled confusions. */
.exam-traps{margin:28px 0 8px;padding:18px 22px 14px;background:var(--warm);color:var(--warning);border-left:3px solid var(--warning)}
.exam-traps>h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:15px;color:var(--warning)}
.exam-traps ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.exam-traps li{padding:8px 0;line-height:1.75;font-size:16px}
.exam-traps li+li{border-top:1px solid rgba(109,73,26,.18)}
.trap-ids{display:inline-block;margin-right:10px;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--warning);border-radius:3px;font:600 12px/1.7 "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;vertical-align:.1em}
.trap-source{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:12px;opacity:.85}
@media(max-width:600px){.exam-traps{padding:14px 14px 10px}.exam-traps li{font-size:15px}.tier-chip{margin-right:8px}}
@media print{.exam-traps{break-inside:avoid;border-left-width:2px}}
body[data-lang=both] :is(.tier-chip,.key-traps)>.en{color:inherit}
/* Deadlines: one mini track per row, each with its own starting event. */
.deadline-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;margin:0 0 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.deadline-legend>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.deadline-key{display:inline-block;flex:none;width:28px;height:6px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;background:var(--accent)}
.deadline-key.late{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--muted) 0 3px,transparent 3px 6px);opacity:.55;border-radius:0}
.deadline-key.anchor{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);border:2.5px solid var(--accent)}
.deadline-chart{border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.deadline-group+.deadline-group{margin-top:22px}
.deadline-group-title{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.02em}
.deadline-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.5fr);column-gap:28px;row-gap:4px;padding:16px 0 18px}
.deadline-row+.deadline-row{border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.deadline-label h4{margin:0;font-size:16px;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.6}
.deadline-start{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.deadline-start>b{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-right:8px}
.deadline-rule{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6}
body[data-lang=en] .deadline-start .en,body[data-lang=both] .deadline-start :is(.tc,.en){display:inline;margin:0}
body[data-lang=both] .deadline-start .en::before{content:" / "}
.deadline-track{position:relative;height:30px;margin:24px 0 26px;align-self:start;background:linear-gradient(var(--line),var(--line)) 0 50%/100% 1px no-repeat}
.deadline-seg{position:absolute;left:var(--from);width:calc(var(--to) - var(--from));top:50%;height:6px;transform:translateY(-50%)}
.deadline-seg.window{background:var(--accent)}
.deadline-seg.window2{background:var(--accent);opacity:.55}
.deadline-seg.late{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--muted) 0 3px,transparent 3px 6px);opacity:.55}
.deadline-seg-label{position:absolute;left:var(--at);bottom:100%;transform:translateX(-50%);font:600 12px/18px "DM Mono",Consolas,"Microsoft JhengHei",monospace;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}
.deadline-seg-label.late{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.deadline-anchor{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:50%;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:var(--paper);border:2.5px solid var(--accent);z-index:1}
.deadline-anchor-label{position:absolute;left:var(--at);top:100%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-style:normal;font-size:12px;line-height:20px;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
:is(.deadline-seg-label,.deadline-anchor-label).edge-left{transform:translateX(-8px)}
:is(.deadline-seg-label,.deadline-anchor-label).edge-right{transform:translateX(calc(-100% + 8px))}
.deadline-note{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}
/* Identity data: three customer types side by side; counts make list length explicit. */
.id-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.id-column{padding:18px 18px 16px}

.id-column>h4{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:17px;color:var(--accent);line-height:1.5}
.id-para{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
.id-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.id-count{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:24px;height:24px;padding:0 6px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper);font:600 13px "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace}
.id-list{margin:0;padding-left:22px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65}
.id-list li{padding:2px 0}
.id-list.verify li::marker{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.id-list.sources{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}
.id-note{margin:12px 0 0;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted)}
body[data-lang=both] .id-list .en,body[data-lang=both] .id-step .en{margin-top:0}
body[data-lang=both] .id-step .en::before{content:" / "}
body[data-lang=both] .id-step .en{display:inline}
@media(max-width:900px){.id-columns{grid-template-columns:1fr}.id-column+.id-column{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.id-column{padding:16px 0}}
@media(max-width:600px){

}

/* Ruling marks: a number beside each point or figure that applies a recorded ruling. */
:root{--ruling:#5b3f86;--ruling-wash:#f5f1fa;--ruling-line:#d9cfea}
.concept-list li.ruled{padding-left:.7em;border-left:2px solid var(--ruling-line)}
.ruling-chip{display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;padding:0 6px;border:1px solid var(--ruling);border-radius:3px;background:var(--ruling-wash);color:var(--ruling);font:600 12px/1.7 "DM Mono",Consolas,monospace;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:.1em;white-space:nowrap}
.ruling-chip+.ruling-chip{margin-left:4px}
.ruling-chip>span{margin-right:3px;font:400 12px/1 "Segoe UI Symbol","Apple Symbols",sans-serif}
.ruling-chip:hover{background:var(--ruling);color:var(--paper)}
.ruling-chip.kind-lang{border-style:dashed}
.ruling-chip.kind-unlisted{border-style:dotted;background:var(--paper)}
.ruling-check{margin:8px 0 0;padding:6px 10px;border-left:3px solid var(--warning);background:var(--warm);color:var(--warning);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}

function tier(t){
 if(!['all','MU','M'].includes(t))t='all';
 document.body.dataset.tier=t;

 remember('tier',t);

 remember('rulings',on?'on':'off');

 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--anchor-offset',(Math.ceil(toolbar.getBoundingClientRect().height)+16)+'px');
}

 if(target)target.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});

 if(!['tc','en','both'].includes(lang))lang='tc';
 const destination=document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1)));

 try{sessionStorage.setItem('mso-study-language',lang)}catch{}
 document.querySelectorAll('.part-nav a,.practice-link,footer a,.visual-links a,.ruling-elsewhere a').forEach(a=>{

 });
 anchorOffset();

 if(atDestination)requestAnimationFrame(()=>{anchorOffset();revealHash()});
}

rulings(recall('rulings')==='on'||/^#ruling/.test(location.hash));

it does not require routine re-verification of an already verified identity absent doubts. Review high-risk customers <strong class="recall-term">at least annually</strong>. Regular review of dormant customers’ existing CDD records is unnecessary, but review should occur upon relationship reactivation; policies/procedures should clearly define a dormant customer.</span></li><li class="ruled" id="rule-monitoring-0-1"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">交易監察一方面檢查交易與客戶業務、風險及<strong class="recall-term">資金來源</strong>是否一致，另一方面識別複雜、異常大額或異常模式且無明顯經濟／合法目的的交易，調查背景目的並書面記錄。<a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E33" title="裁決 E33：交易須相符：客戶、業務、風險狀況「及」資金來源，還是「或」"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E33</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E41" title="裁決 E41：須書面審查的交易：複雜／異常「並且」無明顯目的，還是兩組"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E41</a></span><span class="en" lang="en">Monitoring checks consistency with customer business/risk/fund sources and identifies complex, unusually large or unusual-pattern transactions with no apparent economic/lawful purpose, examining their background/purpose and recording findings.<a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E33" title="Ruling E33: Transactions must fit customer, business, risk profile “and” source of funds, or 或"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E33</a><a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E41" title="Ruling E41: Transactions to examine in writing: complex or unusual “and” without purpose, or two groups"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E41</a></span></li><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">監察宜採整體關係視角，跨戶口及關連客戶，而非只逐筆看。參數包括金額／頻率、相連系列、對手、<strong class="recall-term">資金來源</strong>／目的地及平常戶口活動，須定期覆核及獨立驗證。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Prefer a holistic relationship view across accounts/related customers rather than isolated transactions. Parameters include amount/frequency, series, counterparties, geographical origin/destination and normal activity, with regular review and independent validation.</span></li><li class="ruled" id="rule-monitoring-0-3"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">交易與客戶背景不符，或屬異常且無明顯目的，任一類情況都須適當查詢。解釋滿意可不再行動但應考慮更新風險；不能滿意解釋而形成懷疑則報JFIU，並記錄結果及理由。<a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E6" title="裁決 E6：何時須查究交易：任一警號，還是兩者同時出現"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E6</a></span><span class="en" lang="en">Either profile inconsistency or unusual activity lacking an apparent purpose calls for appropriate enquiries. A satisfactory explanation may require no further action but may update risk; unresolved grounds leading to suspicion require JFIU reporting and documented findings/reasons.<a class="ruling-chip kind-one" href="#ruling-E6" title="Ruling E6: When to look into a transaction: either warning sign, or both"><span aria-hidden="true">⚖</span>E6</a></span></li></ul><div class="citations"><div class="source-citation"><div class="tc" lang="zh-Hant"><a href="../../docs/TC/03_%E9%AB%98_%E6%89%93%E6%93%8A%E6%B4%97%E9%8C%A2%E5%8F%8A%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E5%88%86%E5%AD%90%E8%B3%87%E9%87%91%E7%B1%8C%E9%9B%86%E6%8C%87%E5%BC%95%EF%BC%88%E9%87%91%E9%8C%A2%E6%9C%8D%E5%8B%99%E7%B6%93%E7%87%9F%E8%80%85%E9%81%A9%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%882023%E5%B9%B46%E6%9C%88%EF%BC%89.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">03_高_打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引（金錢服務經營者適用）（2023年6月）.pdf</a><span class="locator">第5.1–5.14段及註52–53</span></div><div class="en" lang="en"><a href="../../docs/EN/03_High_Guideline%20on%20AML-CFT%20for%20Money%20Service%20Operators%20%28Jun%202023%29.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">03_High_Guideline on AML-CFT for Money Service Operators (Jun 2023).pdf</a><span class="locator">¶5.1–5.14; footnotes 52–53</span></div></div></div></div><div class="concept-block tier-block-M"><h3><span class="tier-chip tier-M"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">必記</span><span class="en" lang="en">Remember</span></span><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">2012年4月1日前建立的關係</span><span class="en" lang="en">Relationships established before 1 April 2012</span></h3><ul class="concept-list"><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">原有客戶並非永久免CDD：異常／可疑或與已知背景、業務、風險／<strong class="recall-term">資金來源</strong>不符的交易，戶口運作重大改變、出現懷疑或質疑原資料時，須做CDD。休眠重新啟用或<strong class="recall-term">實益擁有人</strong>／控制權改變可屬觸發事件。持續監察一直適用。</span><span class="en" lang="en">Pre-existing customers are not permanently exempt. CDD is triggered by unusual/suspicious or profile-inconsistent transactions, material account changes, suspicion or doubts about old information. Reactivation or ownership/control changes may trigger review; ongoing monitoring always applies.</span></li></ul><div class="citations"><div class="source-citation"><div class="tc" lang="zh-Hant"><a href="../../docs/TC/03_%E9%AB%98_%E6%89%93%E6%93%8A%E6%B4%97%E9%8C%A2%E5%8F%8A%E6%81%90%E6%80%96%E5%88%86%E5%AD%90%E8%B3%87%E9%87%91%E7%B1%8C%E9%9B%86%E6%8C%87%E5%BC%95%EF%BC%88%E9%87%91%E9%8C%A2%E6%9C%8D%E5%8B%99%E7%B6%93%E7%87%9F%E8%80%85%E9%81%A9%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%89%EF%BC%882023%E5%B9%B46%E6%9C%88%EF%BC%89.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">03_高_打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引（金錢服務經營者適用）（2023年6月）.pdf</a><span class="locator">第4.12.1–4.12.3段</span></div><div class="en" lang="en"><a href="../../docs/EN/03_High_Guideline%20on%20AML-CFT%20for%20Money%20Service%20Operators%20%28Jun%202023%29.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">03_High_Guideline on AML-CFT for Money Service Operators (Jun 2023).pdf</a><span class="locator">¶4.12.1–4.12.3</span></div></div></div></div><div class="concept-block tier-block-M"><h3><span class="tier-chip tier-M"><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">必記</span><span class="en" lang="en">Remember</span></span><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">監察制度設計與資料供應</span><span class="en" lang="en">Monitoring-system design and information access</span></h3><ul class="concept-list"><li><span class="tc" lang="zh-Hant">制度的設計、自動化及精密程度須按業務規模／複雜度、風險、現有系統及管控、其他業務監察程序，以及產品和交付方式而定，不是一律強制自動化。須及時向負責監察／調查的相關員工提供足夠資料，以識別及分析客戶交易。</span><span class="en" lang="en">System design, automation and sophistication depend on business size/complexity, risk, existing systems/controls, other business monitoring and products/delivery.
